rows.jyutping: gong2 faan2 A ge3 jyun4 waa6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial construction for repeating someone’s exact words.

example.english: I’m just going to quote my mother’s exact words; I didn’t make them up.
example.traditional: 我淨係講返阿媽嘅原話，唔係我自己作㗎。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zing6 hai6 gong2 faan1 aa3 maa1 ge3 jyun4 waa6 m4 hai6 ngo5 zi6 gei2 zok3 gaa3

rows.note: Use this formal verb especially in writing, speeches, or academic contexts.

example.english: In this paper, we quote many scholars’ exact words.
example.traditional: 呢篇論文引用咗好多學者嘅原句。
example.jyutping: ne1 pin1 leon6 man4 jan5 jung6 zo2 hou2 do1 hok6 ze2 ge3 jyun4 geoi3

rows.note: Use 報價 for a set-price estimate for work or goods; the other renderings refer to different senses.

example.english: After we look at the renovation work, we can give you a quote.
example.traditional: 我哋睇完你間屋嘅工程，就可以畀你一份報價。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 tai2 jyun4 nei5 gaan1 uk1 ge3 gung1 cing4 zau6 ho2 ji5 bei2 nei5 jat1 fan2 bou3 gaa3

rows.note: Use 引號 when referring to quotation marks in writing, rather than to quoted words or a price estimate.

example.english: Put this quote in quotation marks so it is clear that it is someone else’s words.
example.traditional: 呢句說話要用引號括住，先至清楚係引用人哋嘅。
example.jyutping: ne1 geoi3 syut3 waa6 jiu3 jung6 jan5 hou6 gwaat3 zyu6 sin1 zi3 cing1 co2 hai6 jan5 jung6 jan4 dei6 ge3

rows.note: For an attributed quotation, 引用 is the all-purpose choice in formal or written contexts; it does not mean quotation marks or a price estimate.

example.english: The quote in the report is from Lu Xun.
example.traditional: 報告入面嗰段引用係出自魯迅嘅。
example.jyutping: bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 go2 dyun6 jan5 jung6 hai6 ceot1 zi6 lou5 seon3 ge3
